P.name: Iceborn Subjugation
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever a nearby enemy champion dies, '''Lissandra''' spawns a ''Frozen Thrall'' from their corpse.

''Frozen Thralls'' are ice spirits that have {{as|{{pp|325*.103;325*.242;325*.361;325*.461;325*.547;325*.619;325*.681;325*.733;325*.778;325*.812;325*.848;325*.876;325*.899;325*.919;325*.935;325*.95;325|0 to 4|type=seconds alive}} movement speed}} and {{tip|slow}} nearby enemies by 25%. They will chase nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemies for 4 seconds, prioritizing {{tip|champion|champions}}, after which they shatter to deal {{as|{{pplevel|120; then +20*x for 11; then +30*x|formula=100 + 20 per level until level 12, then +30 per level}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.

Q.name: Ice Shard
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lissandra''' launches a shard of ice in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} enemies hit for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
Q.description2: If ''Ice Shard'' hits an enemy, it will shatter, increasing its width and maximum range.

W.name: Ring of Frost
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lissandra''' freezes nearby enemies, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|root|rooting}} them for a duration.
W.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 210}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}}
{{st|Root Duration|{{ap|1.25 to 1.65}} seconds}}

E.name: Glacial Path
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lissandra''' sends a claw of ice in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies it passes through, decelerating over {{fd|1.25}} seconds. ''Glacial Path'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds while the claw is active.
E.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Lissandra''' {{tip|blinks}} to the claw's current location, ending its trajectory.

R.name: Frozen Tomb
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lissandra''' can cast ''Frozen Tomb'' on herself or an enemy champion.
R.description2: {{sbc|Enemy Cast:}} '''Lissandra''' freezes the target enemy champion, {{tip|knockdown|knocking them down}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
R.description3: {{sbc|Self Cast:}} '''Lissandra''' instantly entombs herself in ice, entering {{tip|stasis (buff)|stasis}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds and {{tip|healing}} herself every {{fd|0.25}} seconds over the duration. The healing is increased by {{as|{{pp|type='''missing''' health at the time of cast|key=%|0 to 100 for 11|key1=%|0 to 100|formula=1% per 1% of '''missing''' health}}}}.
R.leveling3:
{{st|Minimum Heal per Tick|{{ap|100/10 to 200/10}} {{as|(+ {{ap|55/10}}% AP)}}|Maximum Heal per Tick|{{ap|100*2/10 to 200*2/10}} {{as|(+ {{ap|55*2/10}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Minimum Total Heal|{{ap|100 to 200}} {{as|(+ 55% AP)}}|Maximum Total Heal|{{ap|100*2 to 200*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|55*2}}% AP)}}}}
R.description4: ''Frozen Tomb'' creates a field of ice that spreads out from the target over {{fd|1.5}} seconds and covers the surrounding area for 3 seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for {{fd|0.5}} seconds, refreshing every {{fd|0.25}} seconds while they remain.
